$comment: Phrase lists for .github/scripts/crisis-conformance.sh, which scans every repo's SKILL.md (read-only) for the crisis and scope rules every Access To skill must carry. Phrase matching is case-insensitive and literal (no regex). Every phrase check reads SKILL.md with the shared disclaimer block blanked out, so the stamped notice never satisfies a rule. required_numbers_outside_notice: when true (the default), a number found only inside the notice is reported as 'notice only', a finding; set it to false to let the notice count. missouri_labels are whole-word, case-sensitive. Edit the wording here; the script does not need to change. Keep phrases specific to an instruction: loose ones such as "your state" ("replace Missouri data with your state's") or "in Spanish" ("brochure available in Spanish") pass skills that have no rule at all.
